title: Part
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Begin with the first loop by drawing a line from the origin to a point 0.75 units along the x-axis, then another line up to 0.1094 units along the y-axis, followed by a line back to the origin. In the second loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0659, 0.0547) with a radius of 0.0501 units. For the third loop, draw another circle centered at (0.2204, 0.0547) with the same radius. Continue with the fourth loop by drawing a circle centered at (0.375, 0.0547) with a radius of 0.0502 units. In the fifth loop, draw a circle centered at (0.5297, 0.0547) with a radius of 0.0503 units. Finally, for the sixth loop, draw a circle centered at (0.6846, 0.0547) with the same radius. Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.75. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using Euler angles set to zero degrees and translating it using a vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0109 units in the direction of the normal without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body using the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the part are 0.7500000007633176 units in length, 0.10942672767215068 units in width, and 0.010854307847032377 units in height.

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall dimensions
length = 0.7500
width = 0.1094
thickness = 0.0109

# Hole parameters
num_holes = 5
hole_dia = 0.0937
hole_r = hole_dia / 2.0

# Spacing: holes evenly distributed along the length
spacing = (length - hole_dia) / num_holes

# Base plate
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(length, width, thickness, centered=(True, True, False))

# Cut holes through the plate
for i in range(num_holes):
    x = -length / 2.0 + hole_dia / 2.0 + spacing * (i + 0.5)
    plate = plate.faces(">Z").workplane(origin=(0, 0, 0)) \
        .center(0, 0) \
        .pushPoints([(x, 0)]) \
        .hole(hole_dia)

r = plate

lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Base plate: 0.75 x 0.1094 x 0.0109
plate = cq.Workplane("XY").box(0.75, 0.1094, 0.0109)

# Five circular through-holes evenly spaced along the length
hole_radius = 0.04687
spacing = 0.15
x_start = -2 * spacing  # centers at -0.30, -0.15, 0.0, 0.15, 0.30

points = [(x_start + i * spacing, 0.0) for i in range(5)]

r = plate.faces(">Z").workplane().pushPoints(points).hole(2 * hole_radius)
